method: split conformal on the signed residual of the monthly total (actual - predicted); lower bound clipped at 0

calibration.model: EXTRATREES_V1 {'n_estimators': 40, 'max_depth': 12, 'min_samples_leaf': 20, 'max_features': 1.0}, random_state 37, refitted on target months 4-12 (2025-07 to 2026-03) for the 440 training households; the shipped model trained on 13-15, so its own residuals there would be in-sample

fallback_if_undercovered.rule: if verified coverage is below 80% for either household group, recompute from the same 13-15 residuals at a 90% nominal level and verify once more; fixed before the holdout was read
